To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the fragmentation results for the color-singlet contributions to the inclusive production cross sections of $\eta_{c}, J/\psi, \chi_{cJ}$ (J=0,1,2), and $c\bar c$ in $e^+\, e^-$ annilation substantially overestimate the exact results by a factor of 2 to 4 at $\sqrt s = 10.6$ GeV; (2) the fragmentation results become good approximation only

the fragmentation results substantially underestimate the color-singlet contributions to the $\chi_{c0}$ and $\chi_c1$ inclusive cross sections at $\sqrt{s}= 10.6$ GeV, and that the color-octets contributions to $\chi_c1, \chi_c2$ inclusive cross sections are significant.

the complete ${\mathcal{O}}(\alpha_{\rm s}^{2})$, inclusive production cross section of the $c\bar c$ pair plus $c\overline c$ is dominated by the fragmentation process for $\sqrt s\gtrsim 10$ GeV, and that the color-octect contributions are important for inclusive production of $\chi_{c 1}$ and $\chic2$.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the inclusive production of charmonium plus $c\overline{c}$ in electron-positron annihilation.
the production of inclusive charmonium via double $c\bar c$ in $e^{ + } e^{ - }$ annihilation.
the inclusive production of charmonium plus $c \bar c$ via double $c\bar c$ in $e^+$ $e^-$ annihilation, including both the color-singlet contributions and the color-octets contributions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the color-singlet fragmentation results overestimate these cross sections at $\sqrt{s}= 10.6$ GeV.
the Belle observation of double $c\bar c$ is consistent with the fragmentation picture, and that a large color-octet production of $\chi_{c}$ is not excluded by this experiment.
the Belle observation of double charm production is consistent with both the color-singlet model and the color-octets contributions to the color-singlets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the color-singlet fragmentation calculations can only be used to describe the charmonium production cross sections at $\sqrt{s}\gtrsim 100$GeV, and the color-octets can play a non-negligible role in the production of $\chi_{c}$ via double $c\bar c$ at Belle and BaBar energies.
the fragmentation results are not reliable for the inclusive production of $J/\psi, \chi_{cJ}$ at Belle and BaBar energies.

the fragmentation approach to inclusive charmonium production in $e^{+\,}e^{-}$ annihilation is valid only for energies above about 100GeV and that the contribution of the color-octets can be important in $\chi_{c}$ production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the double charm production of charmonia via double charm quark pairs is not negligible at the Belle and the BaBar energies.
the fragmentation approach can not be trusted for inclusive charmonium production at the Belle and Babar energy, while it can become a good approximation at high energies, e.g. at the LHC.
one should not use the approximate fragmentation results to estimate the cross sections for inclusive charmonium production in the Belle energy range.
